title: 第5348章 你威胁我第5347章 我是领头人
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：九龙归一诀陆沉第5348章你威胁我（..la）其实，人族援军不是一百万，而是一百多万，比骨族援军还要多出几十万。
看双方的援军数量，人族方就比骨族方多，人多力量大，战力就强。
光是庞大带来的一百多万人族援军，就够骨族这边吃不了兜着走，已经没有多少胜算。
再加上，韩兰的十万人族大军，还在盾防的加持下，简直是一支生猛无畏的猛虎，可以硬刚骨族的百万大军也不落下风。
一大一小的人族两支军队，直接来了一发前后夹攻，骨族大军瞬间阵脚大乱、难以抵挡。
陆沉还是率先打头阵的那一位，领着十万人族大军在前线大打反击，打得骨族的前锋部队伤亡惨重，而自身却没多少损失。
但庞大率领的人族援军却不是如此了，虽然打得骨族的后军招架不住，也斩杀骨人无数，可自身损失也很大。
毕竟，人族援军没有享受到盾防加持，防御力没有额外增长，战损较大也是难以避免的。
没办法，人族援军是一百多万，肥龙哪有那么多盾防可加，只好干脆不加。
就算加，也加不过来，那可是一百多万人啊！
加持十余万人的盾防，已经是肥龙的极限，再多就干不过来了。
虚神境的盾修能力，也就这么多了。
想要再多，肥龙就得提升修为，再突破一个大境界！
反正，人族援军的兵力比整支骨族大军都要多，实力也足够打，没有盾防加持一样打得赢，就不要去计较损失了。
骨族大军这边想撤撤不了，在人族援军的逼迫下，只能硬着头皮开打，但原本的优势尽失，也打得十分糟糕，不可能有赢的机会。
仅一炷香的功夫，骨族后军就没顶住人族援军的强大攻势，战线硬生生被打崩一个缺口，又没有能力将缺口填上，结果那个缺口被越撕越大。
人族援军全力从那个缺口下手，几乎将骨族的战线撕成了两半，骨族后军的防线也随之崩塌下来了。
骨族后军崩溃，直接影响到骨族前军，乃至整支骨族大军。
骨族的前军在慌乱之中，也顶不住陆沉率众的攻势，一个防御点被陆沉一力打穿之后，很快拉动了整条战线的坍塌。
两头战斗，两头抵抗，却是两头崩溃，这支百万级别的骨族大军终于迎来了大败。

骨族大军无心恋战、四散逃蹿，想要夺路而逃。
但是，所有退路皆被人族援军堵死，根本冲不出去。
眼见大军逃不掉，无数部属被杀戮，那个骨族高层急了，只好冲着庞大叫喊：“做人留一线，他日好相见，既然我们已经失败了，你们没必要将我们赶尽杀绝吧。”
“你们在围攻我们人族军队的时侯，那可是围得死死的，又不见你们会留一线，我只见到你们要赶尽杀绝的狠样。”
庞大哼了一声，又如此回怼，“现在你们打不过了，居然懂得讲他日好相见了，你倒是很会说话，我要是傻子的话，我就真的信了你的鬼咯。”
“你们要是杀光我们，我们骨族绝不会善罢干休，从此与你们人族拼个你死我活，谁也休想有安宁之日！”
那骨族高层恼火的说道。
“先干掉你们再说，至于以后要拼死拼活，那打便是了，反正我无所谓。”
庞大嘿嘿一笑，又如此说道，“不过呢，就你们骨族那点实力显然不够看的，你们要是真敢跟我们人族拼命，别到时还真把命给搭上了，也捞不到一点好处。”
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 5348 of Lu Chen, Nine Dragons Returning to Unity, You Threaten Me (..la) In fact, the human race’s reinforcements are not one million, but more than one million, which is hundreds of thousands more than the bone race’s reinforcements.
Looking at the number of reinforcements on both sides, the Human Race side has more troops than the Bone Race side. The more people they have, the more powerful they are, and the stronger their combat power is.
The more than one million human reinforcements brought by Da Pang alone are enough for the Bone Clan to survive, and they no longer have much chance of winning.
In addition, Han Lan's army of 100,000 people, with the support of shield defense, is simply a fierce and fearless tiger, which can defeat the millions of troops of the Bone Race.
The two armies of the human race, one large and one small, attacked directly from the front and back. The Bone Race army was instantly in chaos and found it difficult to resist.
Lu Chen was still the one who took the lead, leading an army of 100,000 people to fight back on the front line. The forward troops of the Bone Clan suffered heavy casualties, but he himself suffered little loss.
But this was not the case with the human reinforcements led by Pang Pang. Although the Skeleton Race's rear army was unable to withstand the attack and killed countless Skeleton Men, its own losses were also huge.
After all, the human reinforcements did not enjoy the blessing of shield defense, there was no additional increase in defense power, and heavy battle losses were unavoidable.
There was no other way. The human race had more than one million reinforcements. Fat Dragon didn't have that much shield defense to add, so he had no choice but to not add any.
Even if we add more people, we still can’t add them in. That’s more than one million people!
Supporting the shield defense of more than 100,000 people is already the limit of Fei Long, and he can't do it with any more.
There are only so many shield-building abilities in the Virtual God Realm.
No matter how much he wants, Feilong must improve his cultivation and break through to a greater realm!
Anyway, the human reinforcements have more troops than the entire Bone Clan army, and they are strong enough to fight. They can win without the support of shield defense, so don't worry about the losses.
The Bone Race army was unable to retreat. Under the pressure of the human race reinforcements, they had no choice but to bite the bullet and start fighting. However, the original advantage was lost and the fight was very bad. There was no chance of winning.
In just one stick of incense, the Bone Race rear army was unable to withstand the powerful offensive of the human race reinforcements. A gap was suddenly broken in the battle line, and they were unable to fill the gap. As a result, the gap became wider and wider.
The human reinforcements attacked the gap with all their strength, almost tearing the Bone Clan's battle line in half, and the Bone Clan's rear army's defense line also collapsed.
The collapse of the Bone Clan's rear army directly affected the Bone Clan's front army, and even the entire Bone Clan army.
The Bone Clan's front army was in panic and could not withstand the offensive led by Lu Chen. After a defensive point was penetrated by Lu Chen, the entire front quickly collapsed.
Two sides fought, two sides resisted, but both sides collapsed. This million-level Bone Clan army finally suffered a major defeat.
The Bone Clan army had no intention of fighting and scattered in all directions, trying to escape.
However, all retreat routes were blocked by human reinforcements, making it impossible to escape.
Seeing that the army could not escape and countless subordinates were killed, the senior Bone Clan leader became anxious and had no choice but to shout at Pang Pang: "Leave a sliver for us so that we can meet again in the future. Since we have failed, there is no need for you to kill us all."
"When you besieged our human army, it was very tight. I didn't see that you would leave any chance. I only saw that you were ruthless and wanted to kill them all."
Pang Pang snorted and retorted, "Now that you can't fight each other, you actually know how to talk about how we can meet again someday. You are really good at talking. If I were a fool, I would really believe you."
"If you kill us all, our Bone Clan will never give up. From now on, we will fight to the death with your human race, and no one will ever have a chance to live in peace!"
The senior Bone Clan executive said angrily.
"I'll kill you first. As for fighting to the death in the future, I'll just beat you. I don't care anyway."
Pang Pang smiled and said, "But, the strength of your Bone Clan is obviously not enough. If you reallyIf you dare to fight against our human race, you will risk your life and gain nothing. "
